messages:
Olivia: Quick sync — I'm drafting the PRD for rate limits / quota billing. Need alignment on semantics (per-token vs per-request), UI flows, and rollout criteria before EOW.
Raj: +1. Can we pin scope: hosted API only for v1? Dedicated/Private later?
Olivia: Yes, v1 hosted API only. Dedicated will follow but design should be pluggable.
Simon: For pricing semantics: recommend per-token + optional per-request flat fee for small calls. Keeps egress predictable.
Maya: Edge case: embeddings vs generation — embeddings are smaller tokens but high volume. Need separate meter and rate class.
Jana: Agreed. Proposal: two meters: generation-tokens and embedding-ops. Different rate limits & pricing tiers.
Raj: What about streaming? Token counting latency and partial billing — we should emit final token count in response headers and usage webhook.
eng-bot: Suggestion: add headers: `X-Token-Estimate`, `X-Tokens-Charged`. Example error payload:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "rate_exceeded",
  "retry_after": 12
}
```
Olivia: Acceptance criteria draft:
- API returns 429 with stable error code and `retry_after` for hard limits
- Soft limits emit warning header and take no billing action for 24h
- Usage webhook fires within 60s of final charge
- UI shows per-key daily+monthly usage, next billing estimate
Simon: Also need migration rules: existing keys get a 30-day grace window, no hard throttles for first 7 days post-launch.
Maya: Edge case acceptance: overage handling — auto-bill vs block. We should default to block but allow customer to opt-in to overage billing via console toggle.
Jana: UI: limits page needs editable thresholds, team notify emails, and a 'request increase' flow that includes business reason and expected QPS.
Raj: Rollout plan idea: beta customers (10 teams) -> 2-week canary -> gradual ramp to 100% with kill switch.
Olivia: Metrics to validate: throttle rate <0.05%, billing mismatch <0.1% between realtime meter and final invoice, no more than 3 severity-2 incidents in rollout.
eng-bot: TODOs assigned: @raj draft metering webhook spec, @simon update SDK docs, @jana mock UI screenshots, @maya write acceptance tests.
Olivia: Can people react with :thumbsup: if this scope + criteria looks good or reply with objections. Need sign-off by Friday.
Simon: :thumbsup:
Raj: :thumbsup: will start spec today.
Maya: One ask — include a section for disputed usage dispute window (30 days) and logs retention (90 days).
Olivia: noted. Adding dispute & audit log rules to PRD.
Olivia: thanks team — capture these in the PRD draft, linking to this thread. I'll ping when the first draft is up for review.
